title: Summer SPF
caption: SPF number tells you how long a sunscreen extends your burn threshold — but in Dubai's summer, the bigger variable is reapplication, not the number on the tube. UV intensity here peaks between 10am and 4pm, and sweat plus AC transitions degrade the protective layer faster than the bottle's 2-hour guideline assumes. Mineral filters (zinc oxide, titanium dioxide) sit on the skin surface and tend to hold up better in high humidity; chemical filters absorb into skin and can need more frequent top-ups. Knowing the difference helps you match the product to the conditions you're actually in. Not medical advice, just the honest basics. Learn more at cliniclick.ae
